bc97af811294f8aa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة آيرون ماونتن عن مدير مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى مدير المبيعات مسؤولية الإشراف المباشر على أنشطة المبيعات وتخطيطها وتنظيمها لضمان توافقها مع الأهداف والخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة للشركة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الأهداف الرئيسية والخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية للمبيعات، وضمان تطبيقها بنجاح والالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. الإشراف على الأنشطة اليومية للمبيعات، بما في ذلك ضبط أسعار البيع ومراقبة حركة المبيعات ومستوياتها لمختلف المنتجات والخدمات مقارنة بالخطط والتوقعات المالية. ضمان التنسيق الفعال مع شركاء العمل وبناء قاعدة واسعة من العملاء، والتواصل المستمر معهم للحصول على ملاحظاتهم حول أساليب البيع والأسعار والعروض المنافسة، وتقديم التقارير والتوصيات للإدارة العليا. متابعة وتوجيه عمليات إعداد التقارير والتحليلات الفنية لأنشطة المبيعات السابقة، ومراجعتها وعرضها على الإدارة العليا مع المقترحات والتوصيات المستندة إلى هذه التحليلات. الإشراف على أداء موظفي المبيعات وتوجيههم نحو أفضل أساليب وممارسات البيع، وضمان فهمهم لمواصفات وخصائص المنتجات والخدمات، وتقييم أدائهم وتوفير الموارد اللازمة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو دور إشرافي ذي صلة. فهم قوي لعمليات إدارة المبيعات وتخطيطها وتنظيمها. القدرة على إعداد الخطط التشغيلية وتحليل البيانات المالية للمبيعات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. قدرة ممتازة على التواصل وبناء العلاقات مع العملاء وشركاء العمل. مهارات تحليلية لإعداد التقارير ودراسة مستويات المبيعات. القدرة على توجيه وتطوير فريق المبيعات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل مدير المبيعات ضمن فريق ديناميكي ويدعم الأهداف الاستراتيجية للشركة في المنطقة. ملخص إذا كنت تمتلك الخبرة المطلوبة في إدارة المبيعات وتتطلع إلى دور قيادي في بيئة عمل احترافية، فإننا ندعوك للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في شركة آيرون ماونتن بالرياض.

bcf9c241ce9e8084.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة المواصفات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال الهندسي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية الخاصة بالمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات والمعايير المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة الوظيفية بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة وفقاً لأعلى معايير الجودة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

bc53d107cf5ccb99.description: About Aramco Digital Aramco Digital is seeking an Industrial Product Expert to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on the lifecycle management of Industrial AI products and platforms, contributing to the company's strategic initiatives in addressing complex industrial challenges. Role Overview The Industrial Product Expert is responsible for defining, developing, and managing Industrial AI products and platforms from conception through their entire lifecycle. This position involves executing product strategy, planning roadmaps, developing business cases, overseeing commercialization activities, and optimizing the portfolio of Industrial AI solutions. The role is designed for a senior individual contributor who will serve as a subject matter expert in Industrial AI product management. Key Responsibilities Define, develop, and manage Industrial AI products and platforms throughout their lifecycle. Execute product strategy and lead roadmap planning for Industrial AI solutions. Develop comprehensive business cases for new and existing Industrial AI products. Oversee commercialization activities and optimize the product portfolio. Translate market opportunities and customer needs into scalable, commercially viable products. Collaborate with customers, business stakeholders, engineering teams, and delivery functions to drive product adoption. Maximize business value and ensure successful market outcomes for Industrial AI solutions. Required Qualifications and Experience Demonstrated experience in defining, developing, and managing industrial AI products and platforms. Proven ability to execute product strategy and manage product roadmaps. Experience in business case development and commercialization activities. Strong understanding of Industrial AI solutions and their application to complex industrial challenges. Experience translating market opportunities and customer needs into product requirements. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant professional experience is required for this role. Key Attributes Ability to function as a senior individual contributor without direct people management responsibilities. Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse internal and external stakeholders. A subject matter expert in Industrial AI product management. Application Process Candidates interested in this Industrial Product Expert position at Aramco Digital are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

bc56bf92e187a14a.company_name: Makkah Clock Royal Tower, A Fairmont Hotel
bc56bf92e187a14a.description: About Accor Accor is seeking a Group Director of Marketing & Communications for its portfolio of hotels in Makkah. This role will lead the strategic direction and execution of marketing, public relations, and communications for four luxury and upper-upscale hotels: Makkah Clock Royal Tower, A Fairmont Hotel; Raffles Makkah Palace; Swissôtel Makkah; and Swissôtel Al Maqam. The position is full-time and based in Makkah. Role Summary The Group Director of Marketing & Communications will report to senior commercial leadership and be responsible for developing and implementing an integrated marketing and communications strategy. This strategy aims to strengthen brand positioning, enhance market visibility, support revenue growth, and reinforce the reputation of each hotel and the wider portfolio. The role requires a strategic thinker with commercial acumen and a deep understanding of luxury hospitality, capable of balancing distinct brand identities with shared group objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead the group-wide marketing strategy, annual marketing plans, and long-term brand development roadmap, translating business objectives into measurable marketing priorities for each hotel. Establish clear positioning and differentiation strategies for each property, ensuring alignment with individual brand standards, target audiences, competitive positioning, and commercial objectives. Translate market intelligence, customer insights, competitive analysis, and demand forecasts into actionable marketing strategies that support business growth. Lead integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns across key domestic and international source markets, with particular focus on Umrah, Hajj, Ramadan, and other high-demand travel periods. Identify opportunities to increase demand and revenue across rooms, suites, food and beverage, meetings and events, and other hotel offerings through targeted campaigns, strategic partnerships, and brand activations. Work closely with Group Commercial leadership, Sales, and Revenue Management to align marketing investment with business priorities, demand generation, and revenue objectives. Develop strategic partnerships with tourism authorities, travel trade partners, relevant organizations, media outlets, and commercial stakeholders to expand market reach and strengthen brand equity. Champion innovative marketing approaches, emerging consumer trends, and new opportunities to enhance competitiveness and market relevance. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 10 years of experience in marketing and communications, preferably within the luxury hospitality sector. Demonstrated experience in brand marketing, public relations, corporate communications, digital marketing, content, social media, CRM, and loyalty marketing. Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking abilities. Ability to foster strong collaboration with hotel General Managers, commercial teams, brand representatives, and external stakeholders. A strong understanding of the Saudi hospitality landscape, particularly the unique dynamics of Makkah’s religious tourism market. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves leading marketing efforts for a distinguished portfolio of hotels within the Abraj Al Bait Complex. The role requires navigating the unique dynamics of Makkah’s religious tourism market to deliver culturally sensitive and commercially effective marketing initiatives.

bc9f9479bc2e30d7.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Food & Beverage Waiter/Waitress to join its team in Makkah. This full-time role involves providing food and beverage service to guests, contributing to a positive and memorable experience during their stay. The position is suitable for individuals with 0-1 years of experience in a related field. Key Responsibilities Maintain a friendly and positive attitude in all guest interactions, actively seeking opportunities to enhance their dining experience. Acquire comprehensive knowledge of all menu items, promotions, and daily specials to confidently assist guests and answer inquiries. Accurately take food and beverage orders, input them into the point-of-sale system, and deliver completed orders efficiently and with attention to detail. Ensure the food service station remains fully stocked, clean, and well-organized at all times. Adhere to all health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations to uphold high standards for guest and team member well-being. Required Qualifications 0-1 years of experience in a food and beverage service role. Ability to work full-time in Makkah. Core Values Candidates should align with Hilton's core values, which include a commitment to Hospitality, acting with Integrity, demonstrating Leadership, fostering Teamwork, exhibiting a sense of Ownership, and maintaining a focus on the Now. About Hilton Hilton is a global hospitality leader recognized for its workplace culture. The company is committed to providing exceptional experiences for both guests and team members, guided by its founding vision of hospitality. Hilton has received recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. Work Environment and Support Hilton invests in the well-being of its team members, offering support and benefits. The company aims to provide a supportive environment for career development and growth.

bcd051fb882ddbe0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة تنفيذ أعمال المساحة المتنوعة اللازمة للمشاريع الإنشائية، بما في ذلك المسح الاستطلاعي والتسوية ورسم الخرائط والمخططات. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية اللازمة لمختلف المشاريع الإنشائية. إعداد مسودات تفصيلية للمنشآت والعوائق والقنوات والطرق الفرعية. تحديد وتثبيت نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط. اختيار وتجهيز الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المناسبة لكل مهمة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية المختلفة. إجراء أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي. تثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية من المخططات على الأرض. نقل مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة وتثبيتها على المخططات. تثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع بدقة. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها. توقيع المنحنيات المختلفة وفقاً للمخططات الهندسية. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية والمنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية، بالإضافة إلى المخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المساحة. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستطلاعية والتسوية المساحية. إتقان استخدام الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المختلفة. مهارة في رسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المساحة في مدينة نجران بالمملكة العربية السعودية، ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة الهندسية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية للمشاريع. عن الشركة شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي هي شركة رائدة في مجال الاستشارات الهندسية، وتلتزم بتقديم حلول هندسية متكاملة لمشاريع متنوعة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا كفني مساحة في نجران، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

bc1d6cdf25f8d2df.description: About Alnafitha IT Alnafitha IT, established in 1993, is a leading independent provider of IT services and solutions in Saudi Arabia. As a fully Saudi-owned company, it has developed into a market leader, offering a comprehensive range of IT solutions designed to meet client requirements. The company's expertise includes Microsoft, AWS, ManageEngine, and Zoho Solutions, delivering strategic IT solutions that support digital transformation and operational excellence. With over 30 years of experience, Alnafitha IT has completed more than 4,000 projects, served over 3,000 customers, and collaborated with over 65 partners. The company focuses on a customer-centric approach, emphasizing engagement, collaboration, and quality in every interaction. Its vision is to be a customer-centric provider for digital transformation and consultation in the Kingdom, fostering innovation and excellence. Alnafitha IT is dedicated to optimizing operational efficiency and effective resource utilization to enhance customer satisfaction. The Role of Sales Associate Alnafitha IT is seeking a Sales Associate to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. The Sales Associate supports the sales team in identifying new opportunities, maintaining client relationships, and assisting in closing deals for IT solutions and services. The role focuses on learning the sales process, building product knowledge, and supporting customer engagement activities to drive business growth. Key Responsibilities Support lead generation efforts by qualifying incoming inquiries and conducting initial outreach. Assist in updating the sales pipeline and maintaining accurate records in the CRM system. Help follow up on marketing campaigns and events to engage prospective clients. Assist in scheduling meetings, demos, and sales calls. Participate in client conversations and note key requirements for follow-up by senior sales staff. Help maintain communication with clients throughout the sales process under supervision. Assist in preparing proposals and quotes with input from senior team members. Support document collection and submission for RFPs, contracts, and client onboarding. Ensure that client documents and sales materials are updated and organized. Coordinate internally with the marketing, technical, and sales teams to ensure alignment during the sales cycle. Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and product knowledge updates. Maintain basic CRM hygiene, including client data, opportunity status, and meeting logs. Provide weekly summaries of assigned leads and prospects. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a sales support or related role. Ability to learn sales processes and product knowledge quickly. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail for maintaining records and documents. Effective communication skills for client interaction and internal coordination. Proficiency in using CRM systems for data management and reporting. Work Environment The Sales Associate will work as part of a collaborative team, supporting various departments including marketing and technical teams. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a company that values employee empowerment and growth.

bc64f5dc470bdb47.description: About the Role MOBCO Group is seeking a Program Management Office Coordinator to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing comprehensive administrative, operational, and coordination support to the Program Management Office (PMO). The coordinator will be instrumental in ensuring effective monitoring, reporting, documentation, and communication across multiple projects within the organization. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to support the PMO in maintaining project oversight and adherence to established project management procedures. This includes coordinating with various project teams, tracking project progress, managing PMO records, and ensuring compliance with reporting standards to facilitate efficient project delivery and communication to senior management. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with Project Directors, Project Managers, and various departments to collect and consolidate project progress updates. Prepare, maintain, and update project schedules, progress reports, dashboards, and performance tracking sheets. Monitor project milestones, deliverables, deadlines, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Assist in preparing weekly, monthly, and quarterly PMO reports for senior management. Maintain and control project documentation, including project plans, meeting minutes, action logs, risk registers, and progress records. Coordinate PMO meetings, prepare agendas, record meeting minutes, and follow up on assigned action items. Track project risks, issues, dependencies, and changes, ensuring timely escalation to the concerned management. Follow up with project teams to ensure timely submission of reports and required project information. Support the implementation and standardization of PMO procedures, templates, reporting formats, and documentation systems. Coordinate with internal departments, including HR, Finance, Procurement, Commercial, and Operations, to obtain project-related information. Assist in monitoring resource allocation, manpower requirements, and project performance against approved plans. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely submission of all PMO reports and documentation. Perform other PMO-related duties as assigned by management. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in a similar role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring active coordination within a dynamic project management office and across various internal departments.

bcb82da90b1592d5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ضيف الله العتيبى للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، الدوادمي. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. سيقوم المهندس الميكانيكي بإعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. فهم قوي لمبادئ التصميم الميكانيكي وأنظمة التشغيل والصيانة. القدرة على إعداد المخططات والوثائق الفنية بدقة. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل الرياض، الدوادمي. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

bc0566f6cc3c480e.job_title: Head Pastry Chef – Premium Upscale Café Concept – Al Khobar
bc0566f6cc3c480e.description: We are currently seeking an experienced and visionary Head Pastry Chef to lead the pastry and bakery operations for a highly anticipated premium café concept in Al Khobar. This role is fundamental in shaping the identity of the venue through exceptional craftsmanship, precision, and innovation. We are looking for a leader who combines technical mastery with operational discipline and a refined creative vision. The Role As our Head Pastry Chef, you will oversee all pastry and bakery production, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with international luxury standards. You will lead the pastry team, manage daily operations, and contribute strategically to menu development, product innovation, and cost control. Your leadership will directly influence guest satisfaction and commercial performance. Your Profile Professional Experience Minimum 5–8 years of professional pastry experience, including at least 2–3 years in a leadership role within a premium patisserie, fine dining restaurant, or upscale café concept. Proven expertise in high-end pastry, viennoiserie, and baked goods, with strong attention to flavor balance, texture, and presentation. Experience managing production planning in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Leadership & Team Development You lead and mentor your team with clarity, structure, and high-performance standards. You are confident in training, scheduling, and developing junior chefs while fostering a collaborative and disciplined kitchen culture. You maintain composure and authority during peak production periods. Menu Development & Brand Alignment You contribute to the creation and evolution of refined pastry and bakery menus aligned with the brand identity. You collaborate closely with senior culinary leadership on tastings, seasonal launches, and product innovation. You stay informed of international pastry trends and apply them thoughtfully to enhance the concept. Operational & Financial Acumen You actively manage food cost, portion control, and waste reduction to optimize profitability. You oversee inventory, supplier coordination, and purchasing to maintain ingredient quality and operational efficiency. You ensure production schedules are organized, structured, and aligned with daily business needs. Quality & Compliance You maintain meticulous attention to detail across flavor, texture, and visual presentation. You enforce strict adherence to food safety, hygiene, and local regulatory standards at all times. You ensure the pastry section consistently meets brand and operational expectations. What We Offer Staff discounts across the wider international hospitality group and sister companies. A very attractive reward scheme program. 2 days off per week + 30 days annual leave. Comprehensive medical insurance. A leadership role within an expanding international concept, with opportunities for future mobility and growth.

bc116aaf808b776c.description: Job Purpose We are looking for an Accountant to handle daily accounting operations, maintain accurate financial records, and support financial reporting for the company and its sister concerns. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of accounting principles, good Excel skills, and a high level of accuracy and professionalism. Key Responsibilities Record daily financial transactions and prepare journal entries. Assist with month-end closing and financial reporting. Perform bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies. Support Zakat and VAT preparation and filing. Maintain accurate financial documentation and records. Assist with internal and external audits. Ensure compliance with accounting standards and company procedures. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Accounting, meeting the educational requirements for SOCPA membership. Strong knowledge of accounting principles and practices. Good proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with ERP systems is an advantage. Knowledge of Zakat and VAT is preferred. 1–3 years of relevant experience preferred; fresh graduates are also welcome to apply. Good command of English is mandatory. High attention to detail, integrity, and professionalism. Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple tasks effectively.

bcb175816d64e32a.job_title: Night Manager (Pre-Opening) - DoubleTree by Hilton Riyadh Olaya North
bcb175816d64e32a.description: Job Description Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Night Manager , you’re not just overseeing overnight hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. Responsibilities Here's what you'll do during a typical day: Manage nightly audits and reconciliation: Oversee the nightly audit process, ensuring accurate financial reporting and adherence to internal controls Drive financial reconciliation: Ensure complete and accurate posting and reconciliation of the day’s financial activity across departments Ensure payment integrity: Verify accuracy of financial and credit card transactions and resolve complex discrepancies Analyze and improve processes: Identify reporting anomalies, assess root causes, and collaborate with department leaders to enhance audit accuracy Support overnight operations: Partner with the Night Manager to handle guest issues and assist in emergency situations as needed Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment Qualifications What It Takes to Make the Stay At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
